options.plan: B2B Free; residency documentation only, account entitlement unverified
options.region: No tenant region selected; storage destinations not verified
options.configuration: Native database password users; provider storage/logs; no federation, custom DB, exports, streams or Private Cloud

conditions: Select B2B Free Public Cloud with native Auth0-hosted database users, not Private Cloud or a custom external database. Hosted profile storage is documented, but no tenant, region, account entitlement or applicable terms were inspected.

The tenant guide lists Australia, Canada, Europe, Japan, United Kingdom and United States localities: https://auth0.com/docs/get-started/auth0-overview/create-tenants. Region/domain labels and assigned sub-localities do not enumerate every at-rest country, replica or provider copy.

The processing guide also describes profile copies from external connections: https://auth0.com/docs/secure/data-privacy-and-compliance/data-processing. Federation, custom databases, Actions, application copies and exports require separate destination evidence and are excluded here.

Review actual provider-managed stores, replicas, logs and backup destinations independently. No Private Cloud regional or recovery guarantee is inherited. Coverage remains UNKNOWN with empty countries; advertised hosting is not full coverage or a compliance verdict.

evidence.summary: The guide distinguishes Auth0-hosted authentication profiles from external databases and application copies. It does not verify every storage country for a selected Free Public Cloud tenant.

conditions: The export policy excludes Auth0-hosted password hashes and private keys from Management API access; obtaining password hashes requires a support request. API unavailability is not proof of country coverage, hardware-only protection or key non-exportability.

Review hosted password stores, signing material, replicas and backup copies against the exact tenant and contract. Hashing, encryption, a tenant domain or credential export restrictions do not locate every stored copy or verify deployed cryptographic settings.

Customer-managed credential stores, federation and exported credentials are outside this native-database scope. Countries remain empty and coverage UNKNOWN; no password, key, support ticket, enrollment, API token or tenant configuration was retrieved or changed.

evidence.summary: The policy limits API/extension export of hosted password hashes and private keys. Those export limitations do not establish credential-copy countries or the tenant's deployed protection.

conditions: The retention guide is subscription-dependent, labels its lowest tier Starter and warns that indexed tenant logs can be delayed. The current Free pricing table advertises one day: https://auth0.com/pricing. This is not verified tenant entitlement, measured retention, complete auditing or immutable history.

Log streaming exports tenant events to separate customer-controlled destinations: https://auth0.com/docs/customize/log-streams. The Free comparison does not include a stream; generic streaming documentation does not establish Free entitlement. No stream, SIEM, webhook or external collector is configured.

Tenant log retention and streaming delivery are not residency coverage. Provider event stores, log replicas and backup copies remain unverified; UNKNOWN with empty countries does not mean logs are absent.

No live log retrieval, stream setup, retention change, paid integration or trial was performed. Any later customer-side log copies need their own destination and commercial-scope evidence, not inherited tenant-region assurance.

evidence.summary: The guide documents subscription-dependent retention and indexing delays, not all log-storage countries. Public Free pricing and generic streaming capabilities are not verified instance settings or completeness.

conditions: The official support article, updated January 5, 2026, assigns Public Cloud user/configuration backups to tenant administrators rather than providing a customer backup/restore service. This does not establish that provider-internal disaster-recovery copies are absent or reveal their countries.

The export-tools article distinguishes tenant configuration from user exports: https://support.auth0.com/center/s/article/Backup-Auth0-Data. Deploy CLI does not back up user information; ordinary exports exclude hosted password hashes. A configuration export is not complete tenant recovery.

No Private Cloud restoration SKU, regional backup statement, retention, measured RPO/RTO or Free support entitlement is inherited. Provider-managed snapshots/replicas and every backup destination remain unverified; coverage is UNKNOWN with empty countries.

Customer export storage is a separate configuration outside this scope. No account, subscription, support ticket, backup, export/import, restore, transfer, snapshot, cloud storage or paid service was created; AuthWeave's ZITADEL/BFF, UI and synthetic evaluator are unchanged.

evidence.summary: Official support separates customer-owned Public Cloud backup/restore responsibility from Private Cloud restoration. It does not enumerate provider-internal backup countries or prove complete Free tenant recovery.
